title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
constraints: Lists are acyclic; intersection means shared node identity, not equal values.
inputFormat:
Implement intersectionOfTwoLinkedLists(headA, headB). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
listFixture is [prefixA, prefixB, sharedTail]. The editor builds two list heads that share the same tail nodes.
outputFormat:
Return the result described in the statement.
Return the intersection node itself; the editor displays its value or null.
